This is a list of [[States and union territories of India|Indian states and territories]] ranked by the availability of [[toilet]] facilities per household. Figures are from the 2011 census of India.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://censusindia.gov.in/2011census/hlo/Data_sheet/India/Latrine.pdf| title=Availability and type of latrine facility | publisher=2011 Census of India, Government of India | year=2011 | accessdate=9 October 2015}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.independent.co.uk/life-style/design/india-biggest-toilet-building-spree-narendra-modi-a8512026.html|title=India is on the greatest toilet-building spree in human history|website=[[Independent.co.uk]]|date=September 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite news | url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-07-30/world-s-biggest-toilet-building-spree-is-a-windfall-in-india | title=World's Biggest Toilet-Building Spree is Under Way in India | newspaper=Bloomberg.com | date=30 July 2018 }}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/politics-and-nation/worlds-biggest-toilet-building-spree-is-under-way-in-india/articleshow/65206911.cms|title = Narendra Modi: World's biggest toilet-building spree is under way in India|newspaper = The Economic Times}}</ref> 

==List==
An increasing trend has been seen in India with how many households have toilet facilities.

Kerala, Mizoram, and Lakshadweep State/UT have a higher number of households having toilet facilities in both 2001 and 2011 in comparison to other states. Lakshadweep has the highest households having toilet facilities 89.2% in 2001, 97.8% in 2011, and 100% in 2017.

Seven states viz. Bihar, Odisha, Assam, Goa, and Tripura are below the national estimate of 25.21% in 2019.<ref name="stateut">{{Cite web|url=https://data.gov.in/resources/stateut-wise-percentage-rural-households-which-have-access-toilets-facilities-12122018|title=State/UT-wise percentage of rural households which have access to toilets facilities as of 12.12.2017|date=18 September 2019}}</ref> 

According to a 2019 report, referring to 2017 data, 25.21% of the country has achieved ODF Status and has full access to toilets.<ref name="stateut" />
